grammar.title: Plural Nouns
grammar.explanation:
Otning koʻpligini yasash uchun odatda **-s** qoʻshiladi:

- book → book**s**, car → car**s**
- -s, -sh, -ch, -x dan keyin → **-es**: box → box**es**, watch → watch**es**
- undosh + y dan keyin y → **-ies**: city → cit**ies**

Istisnolar: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**.

Oʻzbek tilida koʻplik «-lar» bilan yasaladi, lekin son bilan qoʻshilmaydi («ikki kitob»). Inglizchada son bilan ham koʻplik SHART: two book**s**.

grammar.title: Possessive Adjectives
grammar.explanation:
Egalik sifatlari narsa kimniki ekanini koʻrsatadi:

- **my** — mening
- **your** — sening / sizning
- **his** — uning (erkak)
- **her** — uning (ayol)
- **its** — uning (narsa/hayvon)
- **our** — bizning
- **their** — ularning

Ot oldidan keladi: **my brother**, **her name**.

Oʻzbek tilida egalik qoʻshimcha bilan ifodalanadi («kitob-IM»), inglizchada esa ot OLDIDAN alohida soʻz keladi: **my** book. «Uning» oʻzbekchada bitta, inglizchada esa his / her / its ajratiladi.

rules.pattern: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + ot

exercises.prompt: Sara is happy. ___ name is Sara.
Ali has a car. ___ car is new.
They have a dog. ___ dog is big.
Tuzating: Her name is Ali. (Ali erkak)

grammar.title: Have Got / Has Got
grammar.explanation:
Biror narsaga ega boʻlishni aytish uchun **have got / has got** ishlatamiz:

- **I / You / We / They → have got**
- **He / She / It → has got**

Inkor: **haven’t got / hasn’t got**.
Namuna: **I have got a sister.** — Menda bitta opa (singil) bor.

Oʻzbek tilida «Menda … bor» deymiz (joy kelishigi + «bor»). Inglizchada esa ega **I** boʻlib, **have got** fe’li keladi; he/she/it bilan **has got**.

examples.sentence: We have got a big house.
He has not got a car.

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: I + have got + a + brother.

exercises.prompt: Tuzating: She have got a cat.
Inkorga oʻtkazing: I have got a car.
exercises.answer: I have not got a car.

comps.title: Family Builder
comps.passage: This is my family. My father is tall and strong. My mother is nice. I have one brother and one sister. My brother is ten years old. My sister is small and nice.
comps.passageTranslated: Bu mening oilam. Otam novcha va kuchli. Onam yoqimli. Mening bitta akam va bitta singlim bor. Akam oʻn yoshda. Singlim kichkina va yoqimli.

questions.question: How is the father described?
questions.explanation: Matn: My father is tall and strong.

questions.question: How many brothers does the person have?
questions.explanation: Matn: I have one brother and one sister.

comps.title: Listening: My Friend's Family
comps.passage: Hello! This is my friend Sara. She has got a big family. Her mother is a teacher. Her father is a doctor. She has got one brother. Her brother is tall and strong. They are all very kind.
comps.passageTranslated: Salom! Bu mening doʻstim Sara. Uning oilasi katta. Onasi oʻqituvchi. Otasi shifokor. Uning bitta akasi bor. Akasi novcha va kuchli. Ularning hammasi juda mehribon.

comps.title: My Family
comps.passage: This is my family. I have got a big family. My father is a teacher. My mother is a doctor. I have got two brothers and one sister. My brother is tall. My sister is small. We are happy. My grandfather is old and kind.
comps.passageTranslated: Bu mening oilam. Mening oilam katta. Otam oʻqituvchi. Onam shifokor. Mening ikkita akam va bitta singlim bor. Akam novcha. Singlim kichkina. Biz xursandmiz. Bobom keksa va mehribon.
